cwd.description: Absolute working directory used to resolve the new conversation's configuration.

modelProvider.description: Provider override, as in `thread/start`; omission uses the server default.

creditId.description: Opaque reset-credit identifier to redeem. When omitted, the backend selects the next available credit.

idempotencyKey.description: Identifies one logical reset attempt. A UUID is recommended; reuse the same value when retrying that attempt.

newThread.description: Spend a fresh root conversation's reset credit instead of the global login's. Cannot be combined with `threadId`.
